title: Better Sulfur
description: Makes sulfur cubes look simple, smooth and clean!
body:
A resource pack that refines the appearance of sulfur cubes.
This pack remakes the outer texture of the sulfur cube, which makes it look smooth and clear. It will be easier to see blocks inside.
It mimics vanilla style.
![appearance with the texture pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/51fbd14e4233fb2a4c20fb278ff0c894c57d698c.png)
